Predicted Exterior L10 (dBA)
Computer predicted traffic-generated design year exterior L10 noise level in decibels on an A-weighted scale, a means of obtaining a single number representing the sound level of a noise containing a wide range of frequencies in a manner representative of the ear's response by means of reducing, or weighting, the effects of the low and high frequencies with respect to the medium frequencies or speech range frequencies.
Predicted Interior LlO (dBA)
Predicted interior design year L10 noise level in dBA estimated from predicted traffic-generated design year exterior L10 noise level taking into consideration the climatic characteristics of the area and the existing and/or anticipated future structural condition of each building.
L10 (dBA) Exterior and Interior Standard
The design noise levels established by the United States Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration, for various activities or land uses to determine the degree of impact of traffic noise on people, activities and for the evaluation of noise abatement measures.
